description: The nCipher modules: nShield F3 6000e, Shield F3 1500e, nShield F3 500e, nShield 10e, nShield F3 6000e for nShield Connect, nShield F3 1500e for nShield Connect and nShield F3 500e for nShield Connect family of secure e-commerce HSM's are multi-tasking hardware modules that is optimized for performing modular arithmetic on very large integers.
